name: io.github.tkapitan/bc-word-layout-mcp
description: Create, edit, validate and preview Microsoft Word report layouts for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central through deterministic, typed MCP tools.

bcwl_label_suffixes.description: Optional. Comma-separated dataset label-name suffixes (default: Lbl). Leave empty for Business Central's default convention.

bcwl_labels_data_item.description: Optional. Name of a dedicated labels data item (e.g. Labels) whose direct columns are all labels. Leave empty to disable the rule.
